--- ## About Us In PURETRONICS we value win-win kind of partnership with our customers, suppliers & associates. We strongly believe that sturdy and fundamentally strong growth can be achieved on the platform of ethics and fair business play, so we can serve the industry till the horizon. New technologies are always being welcomed in PURETRONICS to serve the society in smart & innovative way. PURETRONICS was established in the year 1990 with a very young and dynamic person under the guidance and support from well experienced & self-made personality Mr. Gopaldas Goyal. As a start it was a small enterprise engaged in manufacturing of DC Drives & Control Panels. Over a period of time the faith of the customer on us encouraged us to add the new range of products for which only limited sources were available in the market with their rules and regulations. PURETRONICS with the support of the customers and well-wishers added a wide range of products in the market to provide complete solution under one roof. The strong support & technological collaboration / partnership with leaders of the world market mainly Europe and Japan was established. Service and Technical support is the strongest and most valued part of our core business. --- ## Certificates \[Image Description: Images of ‘Certificate of Conformity’ ECR/91860 (CE Marking) and ‘Certificate of Conformity’ ECR/16243 (ISO 9001:2015)\] **Scope:** DESIGN, DEVELOPMENT AND MANUFACTURING OF MACHINE SOLUTION EQUIPMENTS, TEST & MEASUREMENT EQUIPMENTS AND QUALITY CONTROL EQUIPMENTS. --- ## Extrusion Line Overview \[Image Description: A detailed technical process flow diagram of an extrusion line. From left to right: Pay-Off (Input Drum), Preheater, Extruder, Cooling Trough, Spark Tester, Output Capstan, Tension Controller, Windup Drum.\] \[Image Description: A secondary technical diagram of an Extruder setup, showing the material flow through the Die and Lubrication Bath to the Pick-up Spool.\] --- ## Laser Diameter Gauge \[Image Description: Product photograph showing two ‘METER 2008’ digital display units. The right unit shows the rear panel with S/R port, power supply input, and electrical connectors.\] ### LASER GAUGE **DIAMETERNon-Contact Measurement & Online Control** **METER 2008LASER MICROMETER 2008** --- ## Non-Contact Measurement Technology **NON-CONTACT MEASUREMENT TECHNOLOGY** Laser series gauges through laser scanning measurement principal is the core technology for the device. A focused low power laser at high scanning rates through a measurement window across the object is the basic technique to accurately measure the product. The material, temperature and colour doesn’t influence the measurement. The device is designed to measure transparent objects also. Specially crafted lens to maintain the accuracy and repeatability of the device. \[Image Description: A technical diagram of the measurement principle. An Emitter projects an ‘Absolutely parallel’ laser beam across a ‘Measuring field’. An object (black circle) in the center casts a ‘Measured dimension (shadow)’. A receiver measures the ‘Laser scan with high rates’ to generate an ‘Output signal (Video)’.\] ### TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

--- ## Features, Benefits & Applications **FEATURES AND BENEFITS** - Using an advanced digital signal processor, LASER series sensor minimizes external inferences. - High accuracy and low drift measurements. - Rugged case construction sealed for longer life. - Flexible communication integration RS232/RS485 and other based on request. - It is less sensitive to product vibration and movements. - Digital outputs for integration like Alarm to notify errors through audio visual means. - Analogue output for further integration with machine for feedback and corrective action. \[Image Description: A digital HMI screen showing a measurement of 5.000 mm, with secondary readouts for velocity (0 m/min) and length (0 m).\] \[Image Description: A compact industrial controller box labeled ‘WIRE DIAMETER MEASUREMENT SYSTEM WITH DATA LOGGER’.\] **APPLICATIONS**
The list of all possible applications and specific benefits of the various Puretronics systems is practically endless. The following represents some of the most typical applications: - **CABLE INDUSTRY:** Diameter & Ovality measurement/control, Average wall thickness, Width/Height, Bare wire, Cores, Bundles, Fillers, Jackets, Sectors, Flat cables, MV and HV cables, Automotive cables, Data cables, Optical fibres, Coatings - **WIRE DRAWING:** Diameter & Ovality measurement/control, Turbo Air Guard for dry lubrication, Wet lubrication, Dry lubrication, Copper wire, Steel wire, Steel cord, Special wires, Profile wires, Optical fibres, Coatings - **PLASTIC & RUBBER EXTRUSION:** Diameter & Ovality measurement/control, Width/Height, Multi strand, Tubing, Tubes, Hoses, Large tubes/pipes, Profiles, Ribbons, Multi strands, Blown Film Diameter - **MEDICAL, COSMETIC, FOOD, PACKAGING:** Diameter & Ovality, Multi strand, Hoses, Rods, Tubes, Blown film diameter, Sausage casings --- ## Spark Tester & Calibrator **SPARK TESTER & CALIBRATORDetect Insulation Faults** \[Image Description: A side-by-side view of a Spark Tester unit with digital controls and a Spark Tester Sensitivity Calibrator unit.\] --- ## Spark Tester Technical Details \[Image Description: A studio photograph of a Live Spark Tester unit, featuring a large white rectangular housing containing the high-voltage bead chain electrode, mounted on a dark metal frame stand.\] **SPARK TESTER**
SPARK TESTING is used to detect insulation faults or abnormalities in wire and cable being produced. Dry cable run through the sturdy bead chain electrode of Spark Tester and is exposed to the selected test voltages. According to various applications and standards, PURETRONICS offers LIVE SPARK, ACUTE SPARK and DC SPARK TESTER, which are generally installed after the cooling end in the extrusion line, inspection line, rewinding line, coiling to detect faults i.e bare patches, pin holes, or shearing of electrical wire and cables. Extensively used for power cable, control cable, telecom cable, LAN cable, RF Cable, automotive wire, building wire. Faults detected can be counted and data can be logged for future reference in order to increase the quality and maximise the efficiency. For easy understanding and fast decoding, data logging graphical representation is also available. For quality assurance various standard electrodes are available such as IS, UL and many more. A directly mounted interface display unit for simple operator control such as display of instrument status, test voltage and other parameters are available. ### LIVE SPARK **Features:** Confirms to major international standards, Digital Display Readout, Easy adjustment of test voltages, Optional fault v/s length graph and data logging, 2 Change over relay output for interlocks. **Technical Specifications**

It is a tall, industrial-grade light grey cabinet on wheels. The unit has a front-facing viewing window, a protruding collection tray, and a signal tower light on the top right.\] **LSP SERIES - STATIC POWDER APPLICATORFOR WIRE & CABLE INDUSTRY** The LSP Series Static Powder Applicator by Puretronics is designed to deliver precise, uniform powder coating for wire and cable manufacturing lines. Engineered with electrostatic technology, it ensures consistent application while maintaining a clean shopfloor and optimal cable dimensions. Used primarily for applying talcum powder, the LSP Series improves cable handling, protects insulation, and enhances downstream processing efficiency. **Why Powder Application Matters** - Reduced friction during cable handling and stripping. - Improved insulation protection, preventing tear-outs. - Moisture resistance, especially critical in humid and coastal environments. - Smooth surface finish for consistent processing. **Key Advantages** - **No Excess Powder:** Prevents over-coating, maintaining uniform cable diameter and avoiding surface lumps. - **Clean Shopfloor Operation:** Airtight design ensures powder remains within the system, keeping the workspace clean. - **Consistent Coating Quality:** Even powder distribution improves stripping performance and reduces insulation damage. - **Low Air Consumption:** Optimized design minimizes air usage, lowering operational costs. - **Efficient Powder Usage:** Controlled application reduces wastage and improves cost efficiency. --- ## Technology & Features **TECHNOLOGY, FEATURES & MODELS** **Technology & Design Highlights** - **Electrostatic Powder Application:** Delivers uniform coating without dependency on compressed air, avoiding moisture and dust interference. - **Built-in Powder Moisture Control:** Integrated heater maintains powder temperature and prevents moisture absorption. Temperature is adjustable as required. - **Automatic Line Speed Synchronisation:** Seamlessly adapts to cable line speed without external feedback signals. - **Compact & Airtight Construction:** Space-efficient footprint with enclosed design to prevent powder leakage during operation. - **Powder Recovery System:** Excess powder is collected and reused internally, improving efficiency and cleanliness. **Smart Operation & Maintenance** - **Intelligent Control System:** Real-time alarms, logs, and diagnostics help operators take preventive action and simplify maintenance planning. - **High-Quality Filters & Components:** Ensures reliable performance and prevents dust contamination. - **Easy Maintenance:** Built with durable components for quick servicing and long operational life. **LSP Series Models**
MODEL LSP-G1 LSP-G2

The main visual is a product photograph of the “PORTABLE HV TESTER 20 KV” model, showing a digital display and control dials.\] **HV TESTER - AC & DC** --- ## DC HV Tester Specifications \[Image Description: An image of the DC HV Tester, focusing on the interface, digital LED displays showing “10.0” and “029”, and the Puretronics branding.\] **HV TESTERS**
Puretronics offers a wide range of HV Tester for the Wire & Cables Industry. HV Testers are mainly used to test the insulation of cables, to avoid any defect to go out of their unit to customer. Puretronics offers both AC & DC HV tester with digital control to create a precise test facility for its customers. **General Features of DC HV Tester** - Easy to operate. - Digital Meter for voltage and current. - Electronic tripping circuit. - Visual indication on status of the test. - MOSFET based electronics with very low current. - Digital Timer to set the time for test. - Soft auto-discharge facility. **Benefits of DC HV Tester** - **Modular usage:** this unique design easy to carry design, it can be used for both indoor and outdoor testing. - **Testing method:** the special design of electronics makes the test very gentle and soft on the cable coil or drum thus not affecting other parameters of the cable. - **Power Consumption:** Very low power consumption as compared to AC one, less than 200W. - **Digital control:** all the setting and display are digital to the user to be able to set and monitor the test precisely. - **Light weight:** Unlike the bulky designs of AC HV Tester, Puretronics design of DC HV Tester is light weight and easily portable, thus allowing to test big drums at non accessible locations as well. **Technical Specifications**
